Show events around a specific log event

:::tip[Learn more]
The Bronto docs explain the platform concept behind this command: [docs.bronto.io/api-reference/context/overview](https://docs.bronto.io/api-reference/context/overview)
:::

```sh
bronto context [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dataset` | `-d` | string |  | dataset (name or UUID) the event belongs to (required) |
| `--direction` |  | string | `both` | before \| after \| both |
| `--limit` | `-n` | int | `50` | events per direction |
| `--sequence` |  | int |  | sequence number of the anchor event (required) |
| `--timestamp` |  | int |  | unix-ms timestamp of the anchor event (required) |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto context --sequence 111721913 -d <dataset> --timestamp 1711535140632
bronto context --sequence 42 -d <dataset> --timestamp 1711535140632 --direction before
```
